gl13.title: Guidelines on the details of the various categories of variations (2013/C 223/01)

categories.label: No variation needed
categories.rule: No submission: the change is managed under the quality system (or an approved protocol).

categories.label: Separate procedure (not a variation)
categories.rule: Use the procedure named in the result (for example a transfer or an Article 61(3) notification).

categories.label: Type IA
categories.rule: Implement, then notify within 12 months (for example in the Type IA annual update). The authority checks it within 30 days.

categories.label: Type IA-IN
categories.rule: Implement, then notify immediately. The authority checks it within 30 days.

categories.label: Type IB
categories.rule: Notify before implementing; if the authority raises no objection within 30 days of a valid notification, the change is accepted.

categories.label: Type II
categories.rule: Implement only after approval: quality-only changes once the opinion or outcome is received; changes to the product information once the decision is amended.

categories.label: Extension application
categories.rule: An extension is assessed like a new application and needs a decision before marketing.

13:B.II.b.1:1.text: Satisfactory inspection in the last three years.

13:B.II.b.1:2.text: The site is authorised for the pharmaceutical form or product.

13:B.II.b.1:4.text: Validation done at the new site where relevant.

13:B.II.b.1:5.text: The product is not biological or immunological.

13:B.II.b.2:3.text: The product is not biological or immunological.

13:B.II.b.2:5.text: At least one testing site stays in the EU/EEA or an MRA country.

13:B.II.b.3:1.text: No change in impurity profile or physicochemical properties.

13:B.II.b.3:2.text: Immediate-release solid oral form or oral solution (not biological or herbal), or a parameter already judged to have no quality impact.

13:B.II.b.3:3.text: Same manufacturing principle and steps, no solvent change.

13:B.II.b.3:4.text: Process controlled by existing in-process controls, with no limit changes.

13:B.II.b.3:6.text: The product is identical in quality, safety and efficacy.

13:B.II.b.3:7.text: Stability studies started, with at least three months of data.

13:B.II.b.4:2.text: Conventional immediate-release oral form or non-sterile liquid.

13:B.II.b.4:3.text: Method changes only those the new size needs.

13:B.II.b.4:4.text: Validation on three batches of the new size, or a validation scheme.

13:B.II.b.4:5.text: Not a biological or immunological product.

13:B.II.b.4:6.text: Not caused by unexpected events or stability concerns.

13:B.II.b.4:7.text: Within ten times the originally approved size.

13:B.II.b.5:1.text: Not required by an earlier commitment.

13:B.II.b.5:2.text: Not caused by unexpected manufacturing events.

13:B.II.b.5:5.text: The new method is not novel or non-standard.

13:B.II.b.5:6.text: The new method is not biological or immunological.

13:B.II.b.5:7.text: The test does not control a critical parameter.

13:B.I.a.1:1.text: Same specifications, methods and route as approved.

13:B.I.a.1:2.text: The active substance is neither biological nor sterile.

13:B.I.a.1:3.text: No new supplier of materials of human or animal origin needing TSE or viral assessment.

13:B.I.a.2:1.text: No adverse change in impurity profile or physicochemical properties.

13:B.I.a.2:2.text: Same route, no new reagents, catalysts or solvents.

13:B.II.a.1:4.text: Markings that tell strengths apart are not removed.

13:B.II.a.3:2.text: Weight adjustment via an excipient that is a major part of the formulation.

13:B.II.a.3:4.text: Stability studies started, at least three months of data.

13:B.II.a.3:8.text: Comparable dissolution on two pilot batches.

13:B.II.d.1:1.text: Not required by an earlier commitment to review limits.

13:B.II.d.1:2.text: Not caused by unexpected manufacturing events.

13:B.II.d.1:4.text: Test procedure unchanged or only minor changes.

13:B.II.d.1:5.text: The new method is not novel.

13:B.II.d.1:6.text: The method is not biological or immunological.

13:B.II.d.1:7.text: The change does not concern impurities (including genotoxic) or dissolution.

13:B.II.d.2:1.text: Validation shows the updated procedure is at least equivalent.

13:B.II.d.2:2.text: Total impurity limits unchanged, no new unqualified impurities.

13:B.II.d.2:3.text: Method of analysis stays the same.

13:B.II.d.2:4.text: The method is not biological or immunological.

13:B.II.e.1:3.text: Stability studies started with relevant data.

13:B.II.e.4:1.text: No change in the composition of the container.

13:B.II.e.4:2.text: Not a fundamental part of the packaging.

13:B.II.e.4:3.text: Stability studies if headspace or surface-to-volume ratio changes.

13:B.II.e.5:1.text: Pack size consistent with the posology and treatment duration.

13:B.II.e.6:1.text: No effect on delivery, use, safety or stability.

13:B.II.f.1:1.text: Not the result of unexpected manufacturing events or stability concerns.

13:B.II.f.1:2.text: No widening of criteria, no removal of stability-indicating parameters, no reduced testing.

multipleChanges.rule: A group follows the procedure of its highest variation type. Groups are allowed for related changes in the cases of Annex III, or when the authority agrees.

IA.label: Notify within 12 months of implementation (annual update)

IB.label: Accepted if no objection within 30 days of a valid notification

II.label: Standard 60-day evaluation (90 days for indication changes, 30 for some safety changes), plus clock stops

EXT.label: Assessed like an initial application: 210 days plus clock stops, then the decision

variation.label: Cover letter listing the variations, their classification and the procedure
Variation application form (eAF), with the present/proposed table and the declaration of conditions met

pi.label: Product information (SmPC, labelling, package leaflet), clean and with changes highlighted

other.label: Cover letter or notification for the procedure named in the result

changeLog.text: Transition edition: about 50 common changes classified with the 2013 guidelines, so cases dated before 15 January 2026 get the answer of the rules then in force.
